g.text: Account has no memberId / Member mapping.
Accounts belong to the single demo context.

+giveTo(otherMemberId : Long, wanted : int, giftId : Long) : PointsLot
Scope: business entities, selected fields and operations, selected enums.
Lines: logical associations by the named scalar ID, not JPA object mappings.
Multiplicities describe normal application data, not SQL foreign-key constraints.
- private; + public. Constructors and accessors omitted.
Controllers, services, repositories, DTOs and configuration omitted.
SavingsPosition can split/move while retaining its original transfer and clock.
LoyaltyService settles anniversaries on access; PointsWallet evaluates expiry at read/spend time.
Gifted PointsLot records preserve the original expiresAt.
